name: Corporate Restaurant Concepts, Inc.
summary: Corporate Restaurant Concepts, Inc. (CRSQ) provides specialized advisory and operational management expertise to restaurants. The company functions through two core segments: the Management Group and the CRC Partnership Program. The Management Group division is dedicated to developing and administering its own network of casual dining establishments. Concurrently, the CRC Partnership Program extends a variety of essential products and support services, catering to both company-run and independently operated eateries. A significant culinary focus for the restaurants under their purview is Mexican cuisine. The comprehensive range of services offered by the company covers critical operational aspects, including food and labor cost optimization, payroll and benefits administration, human resources support, employee training and retention strategies, and credit card processing. Additionally, they provide services such as menu development, sales and marketing initiatives, website design and maintenance, and customer loyalty program implementation. Founded in 2008, Corporate Restaurant Concepts, Inc. is based in Overland Park, Kansas.
